name: install a specific toolchain or runtime plugin at a pinned/exact version
definition: Provision a compiler/runtime/plugin from a pinned release or exact version string and verify the environment reports that version.
failure_mode: version drift or missing build tool makes the environment check fail

name: instantiate a wasm module and call an exported function returning a memory offset
definition: Use a WebAssembly runtime to compile/instantiate a module and invoke an exported function whose return value is an index into the module's linear memory.
failure_mode: Runtime selection or instantiation failure, or misreading the exported call, breaks the link.

name: keep rust sources free of unsafe and foreign-function constructs
definition: Write the crate using only safe Rust with no raw blocks, extern declarations, or FFI bindings.
failure_mode: Any detected unsafe or FFI construct fails the analysis.

name: load a native shared library and call its function with correct ffi signature
definition: Dynamically load a .so and invoke an exported transform routine passing a pointer to the buffer and reading a 64-bit signed return value.
failure_mode: Signature mismatch or pointer misuse corrupts or crashes the call.
